name: agent-help-network
description: Remote MCP server to look up recorded routes for a customer task on a website (refund, return, cancellation, warranty, account recovery, document submission), or to check why a web step is blocked or failing (403, login wall, CAPTCHA, 5xx, timeout). Give it the public hostname and get, for a blocked step, the site's declared agent policy, its official developer path, provider status and one recommended next action. Lookups are read-only and send only the hostname and fixed codes; two optional tools send a short report (report_observation, rate_last_lookup).
